tei:div.tei:p: hūm̐/ theg mchog rdzogs pa chen po yi// bka' yi srung ma dam tshig can// ye shes dbyings las rang shar ba// smug nag khros ma sngags kyi bdag /sbyor sgrol ging chen lcam dral bcas// ma lus 'khor dang bcas pa rnams// dam tshig gnas nas skur bzhengs la// sgrub pa'i gnas 'dir rten la bzhugs// sman rag gtor ma gser skyems dang*// sna tshogs sems can mdangs kyis bskang*// rang rang mthun rdzas bskang rdzas kyis// dam can lcam dral mnyes byas nas// las bzhi'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod//

skal mgon ngor padma las 'brel rtsal gyis spel ba'o// ༈ bhyo/ dpal ldan rang byung rgyal mo dang*// lha chen dpal 'bar ma ning nag /skyes mchog dam can thig le rtsal// gza' rgod srog gi spu gri dang*// zhing skyong dur khrod bdag mor bcas// lcam dral bka' sdod bcas pa dang*// sman btsun bkra shis tshe ring mched// rdo rje g.yu sgron brtan mar bcas// dgyes pa'i spyan gzigs phud kyis mchod// zhi rgyas dbang dang drag po'i las// ma thogs bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod// padma las 'brel rtsal gyis bris pa'o/ / ༈ ho/ dam pa chos skyong ba'i srung ma/ ma mgon lcam dral gnod sbyin chen po 'khor dang bcas pa thugs rten ru mtshon 'di la rten bcas te dgyes par bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar 'dod yon lnga dang*/ khyad par ru mtshon rngam brjid srid pa'i rtse mor bsgrengs ba dam can rnams bzhugs pa'i sku mkhar/ dgyes pa'i longs spyod/ mgu ba'i 'dod rdzas/ mchod pa'i bye brag shugs sgrol dmod pa'i mtshon cha/ las bzhi lhun gyis grub pa'i 'dod yon gyi sprin chen po'i cir yang 'char bar gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ skye med rdo rje dbyings kyi yum chen mo// 'gag med dpal ldan rang byung rgyal mo dang*// dpal mgon sde lnga lcam dral bka' sdod bcas// ye shes dbyings su dbu 'phang bstod par bgyi// dbang drag padma'i bka' sdod dregs pa'i rje// myur mgyogs shugs ldan rol pa skya bdun dang*// bka' nyan 'jig rten dregs pa sde brgyad tshogs// dgra lha'i srog gi thig ler mnga' gsol lo// rnam pa kun gyi mchog ldan stong pa'i gzugs// kun khyab bde chen ngang du ro gcig kyang*// ma rig 'dzin pa'i las rlung gis sprul pa'i// g.yar dam gnyan po chos kyi dbyings su bsres// rnam dag rgyu rkyen ting 'dzin las grub pa'i// mtshan nyid kun rdzogs thugs rten ru mtshon 'di// yang dag don gyis srid pa'i rtse mor bskyed// rno la ngar ldan dgra bgegs snying la 'bigs// gtum zhing dpa' bas bdud dpung g.yul ngo bzlog

/rngam shing brjid pas nag phyogs zil gyis gnon// gtsang zhing mdzes pas dam can dgyes pa skong*// dam tshig mchog gi ru mtshon 'bar ba 'di// 'das pa'i rnam par rtog pa yod do cog /sngar bcol legs pa'i gtang rag chen por 'bul// ma 'ongs rnam par rtog pa gnas bsgyur nas// da bcol legs pa'i zhu ba gcig tu 'bul// chad pa'i gzhung gcig bdag gis mi srong rgyu// chad las don byung don la ma g.yel cig /bcol ba'i phrin las khyod kyis mi mdzad rgyu// phrin las don du gzugs skur bzhengs la dgongs// dbu 'phang gnyen po de ring mi bstod rgyu// phyogs las rnam rgyal brtul zhugs 'dzin pa'i phyir// lhun po'i spo dang nyi zla'i bkrag mdangs kyang*// rngam brjid yon tan 'bar ba'i dpyid du spung*// snyigs ma lnga yi yang mthar ltung ba rnams// nad mtshon dmag 'khrugs mu ge'i mnar ba'i tshe// skyabs 'os dkon mchon rin chen rnam pa gsum// dam can chos srung rgya mtshor bzhengs la 'bod// chos kyi sku ni dus gsum skye 'gags med// longs spyod rdzogs las rnam sprul chos skyong rnams// dam can nyid phyir dam tshig dang bzhes la// 'khor dang gang zag srung skyob dus la babs// sku gsung thugs rten mchod cha man chad nas// brgyud 'dzin bu slob yon bdag yan chad du// dgongs pa'i rgyud la 'byor ba'i brtan g.yo kun// khyed la gnyer du gtad do mel tshe gyis// mig 'phrul las kyang myur ba'i 'jig rten gyi// rgud pa sna tshogs dam can chos skyong mthus// bsrung zhing khyad par bdag cag yon mchod la// lus dang grib bzhin 'grogs nas grogs dan mdzod// gzhi ru 'dug na rdzogs ldan dga' ston spel// byes su gcan phrang chom rkun kha char srung*// dgra dang 'gyed na dpa' rtags ru mtshon phyor// phyogs las rnam rgyal bkra shis bde legs mdzod// ces pa'ang thugs rtain ru mtshon gyi phrin bcol 'di gter chen rin po che'i sde dgu'i ru mtshon gyi 'bul tshig la snying thig rang lugs kyis tshig phrad bsgyur ba 'di dgos dbang gis 2padma las 'brel rtsal gyis spel ba dge legs su gyur cig

/ ༈ bhyoḥ phur pa'i srung ma dam tshig can// bhyo las skyes pa'i shwa na mo// sa bdag bdag nyid chen mo bzhi// rang rang rigs kyi ming po dang*// tshangs dang drang srong srin po dang*// gnod sbyin grul bum lha klu'i rigs// 'bum phrag yangs pa'i mkha' 'gro ma// kun kyang khyod kyi rol pa ste// gcig dang tha dad las 'das pa'i// snang srid kun khyab shwa na mo// 'khor 'das gnyis la dbang bsgyur ma// shwa na'i ma tshogs dam la 'du// dam rdzas bka' yi gtor ma longs// brgyud 'dzin slob ma bu bzhin skyongs// brtan g.yo'i rlung sems brtan pa 'phrog /snyan grags gdul bya'i sgo 'phar phyes// mdzad phrin gegs med gong 'phel nas// don gnyer kun las rgyal kha longs// nyams pa bdun ldan cham la phob// snga dgra sems pa rdul du rlogs// da dgra bod pa phye mar thongs// bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod// ces pa 'di ni bu 'gyur med rdo rje dbus bskyod kyi mtshan mo'i snang char shwa na mo rnams kyi sprul pa spro bsdu'i sgyu ma'i bkod pa mig 'phrul bzhin brtses pa'i mthar gcig tha dad bral ba'i rdo rje glu dbyangs bcas thams cad phyag na ba dan dkar po re re thogs nas 'gro bar mthong ba'i tshe dgos dbang gis padma las 'brel rtsal gyis bris pa'o// maṅga laṃ/ / ༈ bswo/ mi la mgon sa lha dang 'brel// lha dang mi gnyis mi 'brel rgyu// mi bu sdong las mched pa yi// rig 'dzin rtsal 'chang seng chen rgyal// dus gsum sangs rgyas bstan pa la// gnod bgegs ma rungs sems can rnams// 'dul phyir dbang drag phrin las kun// mthar phyin nor bu dgra 'dul rtsal// lcam dral phu nu sum cu dang*// lha klu gnyan gyi dgra bla rnams// rang rang bka' 'khor bsam mi khyab// mchod cing sgrub phyir gshegs su gsol// bdud rtsi skyems mchod sha dang khrag /spyan gzigs longs spyod tshogs mang po// ting 'dzin sngags kyi byin rlabs te// wer ma bswe ru 'od ldan mchod// gling rje skyes bu don 'grub mchod// sprul pa dgyes sde phum dgu mchod// phu bo 'bum pa zhal dkar mchod// byes yag 'dan ma spyang khra mchod// dpal thul yang thul phu nu mchod// lha chen tshangs pa dkar po mchod// phu bo lha bu 'od ldan mchod// nu bo klu sbrul dung skyong mchod// a ne gnam sman dkar mo mchod// dgra bla gnyan stag dmar po mchod// rma rgyal rtse lha bcu gsum mchod// gsol lo mchod do lha rgyal lo// bdag gi mchod bstod khyed bsten nas// 'bod na rmog mo'i 'phru dar mdzod// brten na lus dang grib bzhin 'grogs// rbad na mda' gzhus dpa' kha bstod// rang las 'phags pa'i snyan grags spel// gzhan las rgyal ba'i ru mtshon phyor// gzhi byes gnyis su bsam don 'grub// mi mthun gnod pa phye mar thongs// las bcol thogs med ma g.yel sgrubs//
ces pa'ang khra skya padma rdau rje'i ngor padma las 'brel rtsal gyis spel ba dge'o/// /
